A secondary wastewater treatment system will be installed to reduce the organic strength and solids content of the domestic wastewater to levels that are protective of groundwater quality prior to disposal to the subsurface pressure dosed disposal field. The treatment system consists of upflow solids contact tanks, anaerobic media tanks, equalization tank, and piping, pumps, and controls.
